deceased.name: Izuchukwu Chisom Okeke
deceased.biography:
Some people leave behind more than memories. They leave behind a part of themselves in everyone fortunate enough to have known them.

Izu was a beloved husband, father, brother, uncle and friend whose life touched the people around him in countless ways. His presence, kindness and the memories he created with those he loved will remain with us.

As we mourn his passing, this page is a place to honour his life, remember the moments we shared with him, and keep his memory close.

For his family, especially his wife and their little girl, this is an incredibly difficult time. If you would like to offer your condolences, share a memory, say a prayer or provide practical support, your kindness will mean more than words can express.

Forever loved. Forever remembered.
deceased.quote: Some lives leave footprints that time cannot erase.

approvedMessages.message: Soft Lion will be remembered for his warmth, kindness and the joy he brought to everyone around him. May his memory remain a blessing.

May the beautiful memories you shared bring comfort in the days ahead. You are all in my thoughts and prayers.
May God grant the family strength and surround you with peace during this difficult season.
Your kindness and gentle spirit will not be forgotten. Rest peacefully, Soft Lion.
Thinking of the family with love and prayer. May every precious memory bring comfort.
